notes: Riverwalk by day. The stage-mistress sells her own dugout (boat.riverwalk.stage-canoe, tied at socket.riverwalk.stage-landing, 7244.5, 638); the player buys it, paddles towards the public cove beach (7213.4, 535.0), falls out short of it and leaves it adrift, wades ashore and rests: the rest brings the boat back to its last mooring, the landing it left (its own berth).

steps.name: buy-the-dugout
steps.transition: the stage-mistress's boat window -> Buy the dugout: 150 gold, the stage canoe turns the player's

steps.name: board
steps.transition: E at the canoe: the player steps aboard

steps.name: cast-off
steps.transition: E aboard: the canoe casts off from the landing

steps.name: paddle-out
steps.transition: W on the paddle towards the cove beach

steps.name: fall-out
steps.transition: the player goes over the side: the canoe drifts free

steps.name: save-and-load
steps.transition: save adrift and load: the boat records and the hulls come back as they were

steps.name: ashore-and-rest
steps.transition: ashore on the cove beach, rest eight hours from the pause menu
